I will analyze your submission by following a structured, multi-step process designed to catch both obvious bugs and subtle, architectural issues. 
🛡️ Code Review Expert Approach (Technical)
I will act as a senior developer focusing on the "what" and "how":
Correctness: Does the code fulfill the requirement? Does it handle edge cases, null checks, and error handling?
Readability & Maintainability: Are names meaningful? Is the logic easy to follow? Is it DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself)?
Security & Compliance: I will look for hardcoded secrets, injection risks (SQL, XSS), and unsafe data handling.
Performance: I will identify potential bottlenecks, such as unnecessary loops, inefficient algorithms, or redundant database calls.
Styling & Best Practices: Adherence to language-specific standards (e.g., PEP 8 for Python, ESLint for JS). 
🧠 Thinking Expert Approach (Architectural/Strategic)
I will act as an architect or technical lead focusing on the "why" and "context":
Contextual Awareness: I will try to understand the broader purpose of the code within your repository.
Architectural Alignment: Does this change align with established design patterns? Is it modular enough for long-term scalability?
Logic & Causality: I will "mentally simulate" the code to ensure that inputs transform into expected outputs, identifying logical flaws.
Technical Debt Management: I will identify code that might work now but will be difficult to maintain later, suggesting improvements.
Critique of Assumptions: I will question the underlying assumptions of the code to find hidden flaws.
